## Cleaning Data

```{r}
# Inspecting Raw Data
load_raw <- read_xlsx("./Data/Raw/load.xlsx")
humid_raw <- read_xlsx("./Data/Raw/relative_humidity.xlsx")
temp_raw <- read_xlsx("./Data/Raw/temperature.xlsx")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning Load Data
load_proc <- load_raw %>% 
  mutate(daily_ave = rowMeans(load_raw[ ,c(3:26)], na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(date, daily_ave)

head(load_proc)
tail(load_proc)
```

```{r}
temp_proc <- temp_raw %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(across(3:26, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

temp_rows <- nrow(temp_proc) - 1
temp_proc <- temp_proc[1:temp_rows, ]

temp_daily <- temp_proc %>% 
  mutate(daily_temp = rowMeans(across(-date), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(date, daily_temp)
```

```{r}

humid_proc <- humid_raw %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(across(3:26, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

humid_rows <- min(nrow(humid_proc), nrow(temp_daily))
humid_proc <- humid_proc[1:humid_rows, ]

humid_daily <- humid_proc %>% 
  mutate(daily_humid = rowMeans(across(-date), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(date, daily_humid)
```

## Building Feature Matrix

```{r}
# Combine into one panel
load_data <- load_proc

panel <- load_data %>%
  left_join(temp_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(humid_daily, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)

panel$daily_temp <- zoo::na.locf(panel$daily_temp, na.rm = FALSE)
panel$daily_humid <- zoo::na.locf(panel$daily_humid, na.rm = FALSE)
panel$daily_temp <- zoo::na.locf(panel$daily_temp, na.rm = FALSE, fromLast = TRUE)
panel$daily_humid <- zoo::na.locf(panel$daily_humid, na.rm = FALSE, fromLast = TRUE)

n_total <- nrow(panel)
n_for <- 31

cat("Panel rows:", n_total, "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(panel$date)), "to", 
    as.character(max(panel$date)), "\n")
```

```{r}
make_fourier_features <- function(t_idx, K_w = 3, K_y = 8) {
  feats <- data.frame(t = t_idx)
  for (k in 1:K_w) {
    feats[[paste0("sinW", k)]] <- sin(2 * pi * k * t_idx / 7)
    feats[[paste0("cosW", k)]] <- cos(2 * pi * k * t_idx / 7)
  }
  for (k in 1:K_y) {
    feats[[paste0("sinY", k)]] <- sin(2 * pi * k * t_idx / 365.25)
    feats[[paste0("cosY", k)]] <- cos(2 * pi * k * t_idx / 365.25)
  }
  feats
}

fourier_train <- make_fourier_features(1:n_total)

# Combine: Fourier + weather + non-linear weather transforms
features_full <- cbind(
  fourier_train,
  daily_temp = panel$daily_temp,
  daily_humid = panel$daily_humid,
  cdd = pmax(panel$daily_temp - 65, 0),    # cooling degree days
  hdd = pmax(65 - panel$daily_temp, 0),    # heating degree days
  temp2 = panel$daily_temp^2,
  temp_humid = panel$daily_temp * panel$daily_humid
)

cat("Number of features:", ncol(features_full), "\n")
head(features_full, 3)
```

# Candidate Models

## Model 1 — Ridge Regression

```{r}
set.seed(797)
ridge_fit <- glmnet(X_train, y_train_log, alpha = 0, lambda = 0.1)
ridge_pred_log <- predict(ridge_fit, newx = X_test)
Ridge_pred <- as.numeric(exp(ridge_pred_log))

Ridge_scores <- accuracy(Ridge_pred, y_test)

# Plot
data.frame(date = panel$date[test_idx], 
           obs = y_test, 
           pred = Ridge_pred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "blue") +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("Ridge — Validation Forecast")
```

## Model 2 — Random Forest

```{r}
set.seed(797)
rf_fit <- randomForest(x = X_train, y = y_train_log, 
                       ntree = 500, mtry = 8, nodesize = 5)
rf_pred_log <- predict(rf_fit, X_test)
RF_pred <- as.numeric(exp(rf_pred_log))

RF_scores <- accuracy(RF_pred, y_test)

data.frame(date = panel$date[test_idx], 
           obs = y_test, 
           pred = RF_pred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "darkgreen") +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("Random Forest — Validation Forecast")
```

## Model 3 — Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM)

```{r}
set.seed(797)
gbm_data <- data.frame(y = y_train_log, X_train)
gbm_fit <- gbm(y ~ ., data = gbm_data, 
               distribution = "gaussian",
               n.trees = 500, interaction.depth = 4, 
               shrinkage = 0.05, bag.fraction = 0.8,
               verbose = FALSE)

gbm_pred_log <- predict(gbm_fit, newdata = data.frame(X_test), 
                        n.trees = 500)
GBM_pred <- as.numeric(exp(gbm_pred_log))

GBM_scores <- accuracy(GBM_pred, y_test)

data.frame(date = panel$date[test_idx], 
           obs = y_test, 
           pred = GBM_pred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red") +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("GBM — Validation Forecast")
```

## Model 4 — Neural Network (MLP)

```{r}
# Standardize features for NN
mu <- colMeans(X_train)
sd <- apply(X_train, 2, sd)
sd[sd == 0] <- 1  # avoid divide-by-zero
X_train_sc <- scale(X_train, center = mu, scale = sd)
X_test_sc  <- scale(X_test, center = mu, scale = sd)

set.seed(797)
nn_fit <- nnet(x = X_train_sc, y = y_train_log,
               size = 10, linout = TRUE, 
               decay = 0.1, maxit = 500, trace = FALSE)
nn_pred_log <- predict(nn_fit, X_test_sc)
MLP_pred <- as.numeric(exp(nn_pred_log))

MLP_scores <- accuracy(MLP_pred, y_test)

data.frame(date = panel$date[test_idx], 
           obs = y_test, 
           pred = MLP_pred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "purple") +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("MLP Neural Network — Validation Forecast")
```

## Model 5 — ML Ensemble (Equal-Weight Average)

```{r}
ML_Ensemble_pred <- (Ridge_pred + RF_pred + GBM_pred + MLP_pred) / 4
ML_Ensemble_scores <- accuracy(ML_Ensemble_pred, y_test)

data.frame(date = panel$date[test_idx], 
           obs = y_test, 
           pred = ML_Ensemble_pred) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = obs), color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "orange") +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("ML Ensemble — Validation Forecast")
```

## Comparing Forecasts

```{r}

scores <- as.data.frame(rbind(
  Ridge_scores, RF_scores, GBM_scores, MLP_scores, ML_Ensemble_scores
))
row.names(scores) <- c("Ridge", "RandomForest", "GBM", "MLP", "ML_Ensemble")

best_model_index <- which.min(scores[, "RMSE"])
cat("The best ML model by RMSE is:", row.names(scores)[best_model_index])
```


## All ML Models on Validation Period

```{r}
plot_df <- data.frame(
  date = rep(panel$date[test_idx], 6),
  load = c(y_test, Ridge_pred, RF_pred, GBM_pred, MLP_pred, ML_Ensemble_pred),
  Model = rep(c("Observed", "Ridge", "RandomForest", "GBM", "MLP", "ML_Ensemble"),
              each = length(test_idx))
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = date, y = load, color = Model)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  ylab("Daily Load") + ggtitle("All ML Models — July 2010 Validation") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Retrain on Full Data and Forecast July 2011

```{r}
fourier_future <- make_fourier_features((n_total + 1):(n_total + n_for))

july_clim <- panel %>%
  filter(month(date) == 7) %>%
  mutate(md = format(date, "%m-%d")) %>%
  group_by(md) %>%
  summarise(temp_mean = mean(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            humid_mean = mean(daily_humid, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(md)

stopifnot(nrow(july_clim) == 31)

future_features <- cbind(
  fourier_future,
  daily_temp = july_clim$temp_mean,
  daily_humid = july_clim$humid_mean,
  cdd = pmax(july_clim$temp_mean - 65, 0),
  hdd = pmax(65 - july_clim$temp_mean, 0),
  temp2 = july_clim$temp_mean^2,
  temp_humid = july_clim$temp_mean * july_clim$humid_mean
)

X_future <- as.matrix(future_features)
```

```{r}
# Retrain all 5 models on full data
X_full <- as.matrix(features_full)
y_full_log <- log(panel$daily_ave)

# Ridge final
set.seed(797)
final_ridge_fit <- glmnet(X_full, y_full_log, alpha = 0, lambda = 0.1)
final_Ridge <- as.numeric(exp(predict(final_ridge_fit, newx = X_future)))

# Random Forest final
set.seed(797)
final_rf_fit <- randomForest(x = X_full, y = y_full_log, 
                             ntree = 500, mtry = 8, nodesize = 5)
final_RF <- as.numeric(exp(predict(final_rf_fit, X_future)))

# GBM final
set.seed(797)
gbm_full_data <- data.frame(y = y_full_log, X_full)
final_gbm_fit <- gbm(y ~ ., data = gbm_full_data, 
                     distribution = "gaussian",
                     n.trees = 500, interaction.depth = 4, 
                     shrinkage = 0.05, bag.fraction = 0.8,
                     verbose = FALSE)
final_GBM <- as.numeric(exp(predict(final_gbm_fit, 
                                    newdata = data.frame(X_future), 
                                    n.trees = 500)))

# MLP final
mu_full <- colMeans(X_full)
sd_full <- apply(X_full, 2, sd); sd_full[sd_full == 0] <- 1
X_full_sc   <- scale(X_full, center = mu_full, scale = sd_full)
X_future_sc <- scale(X_future, center = mu_full, scale = sd_full)

set.seed(797)
final_nn_fit <- nnet(x = X_full_sc, y = y_full_log,
                     size = 10, linout = TRUE, decay = 0.1, 
                     maxit = 500, trace = FALSE)
final_MLP <- as.numeric(exp(predict(final_nn_fit, X_future_sc)))

# ML Ensemble final
final_ML_Ensemble <- (final_Ridge + final_RF + final_GBM + final_MLP) / 4

cat("Final forecast means for July 2011:\n")
cat("  Ridge:        ", round(mean(final_Ridge), 1), "\n")
cat("  RandomForest: ", round(mean(final_RF), 1), "\n")
cat("  GBM:          ", round(mean(final_GBM), 1), "\n")
cat("  MLP:          ", round(mean(final_MLP), 1), "\n")
cat("  ML_Ensemble:  ", round(mean(final_ML_Ensemble), 1), "\n")
```

dir.create("./Forecast_Submissions", showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(template %>% mutate(load = final_Ridge),

write_csv(template %>% mutate(load = final_GBM),

write_csv(template %>% mutate(load = final_MLP),
          "./Forecast_Submissions/MLP_submission.csv")
write_csv(template %>% mutate(load = final_ML_Ensemble),
          "./Forecast_Submissions/ML_Ensemble_submission.csv")
